acceptance: aubrieta_platform provides pure service traits for OS integration: ClipboardService, FileDialogService, and SystemEnvironmentService
Headless / Mock platform adapter operates purely in-memory without requiring a display server
Domain crates stay completely decoupled from OS APIs and window systems
Full test coverage for clipboard text/image transfers and file dialog filters
constraints: Domain crates never call platform APIs directly
Headless first: all services must have deterministic headless implementations for CI
evidence: cargo test -p aubrieta_platform: 5 unit tests + 3 proptests passed
apps/aubrieta-cli: headless clipboard SVG roundtrip and environment inspection passed
non_goals: Raw OS Windowing event loops (Layer 8 GPUI handles window surface creation)
Hardware tablet driver direct IO (wacom kernel modules)
objective: Implementar aubrieta_platform com traits desacoplados de servicos de SO e adapter headless de referencia
title: Portas e Adaptadores de Plataforma
